posts.name: Pinecone3
posts.cooked:
In the primary Multiverse timeline, Baron Blade killed Legacy on the Wagner Mars base, and his daughter took his place on the Freedom Five.  In an alternate timeline, Legacy's daughter was killed instead, causing him to become Iron Legacy.  However, when he invaded the primary timeline, he accidentally saved the Primary Timeline Legacies (Paul AND Felicia) by injuring them too much to participate in the battle where Paul originally fell at the hands of Blade.  This allowed Legacy to retain his place as head of the Freedom Five while his Daughter became Beacon. 

 

My question is, where does the Legacy-less Freedom Six fit in to all this?  The Freedom Six must have fought Iron Legacy, considering he is a nemesis to all of them (The original four non-legacy members + Tempest and Unity). However, Iron Legacy arrived in our timeline while the Freedom Five were still active.  And also, why is Felicia Parsons not a member of the Freedom Six?

 

I think I might know why, but I want to check.  The Freedom Six are from Iron Legacy's timeline, not the primary one.  He fought them there and defeated them, but when he came to the primary timeline he still considered the primary timeline versions to be his Nemeses.
